versions.changelog:
Initial release – generates AI-powered body chain jewelry designs, sketches, and 3D models.

- Generate hand-drawn design sheets, multiview sketches, and 3D jewelry viewers from text and images.
- Supports customization with gemstone images, types, metals, shapes, and materials.
- Multiple jewelry template categories: bracelet, beaded-bracelet, ring, necklace, pet-jewelry-collar, earrings, and body-chain.
- OneKey API integration required for accessing jewelry generation features.
- Includes online interactive web app and quick start instructions.
